The '''OT-9 Artillery Droid''' was a tripedal [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. OT-9 Artillery Droids were among the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] deployed in the [[Markaran Plains]] around the [[Okara Droid Factory]].
